connector.name: Obsidian Hybrid Search
connector.registryDescription: Search Obsidian vaults with hybrid full-text, fuzzy, semantic, and graph retrieval.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package obsidian-hybrid-search. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the flowing-abyss account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the Obsidian vault to index and search.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_PREFIX
env.description: Optional prefix for MCP tool names when configuring multiple vaults.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_IGNORE_PATTERNS
env.description: Comma-separated glob patterns to exclude from indexing.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_RESPECT_GITIGNORE
env.description: Read root and nested .gitignore files when indexing; set to false, 0, or no to disable.

env.name: OBSIDIAN_INCLUDE_PATTERNS
env.description: Comma-separated patterns to re-include notes ignored only by .gitignore.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional API key for OpenAI-compatible remote embeddings; omit to use local embeddings.

env.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
env.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible API base URL for OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, or similar providers.

env.name: OPENAI_EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Remote embedding model name when using an OpenAI-compatible API.

env.name: LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Local embedding model used when no remote embedding API is configured.

env.name: RERANKER_MODEL
env.description: Optional ONNX cross-encoder reranker model used when reranking is requested.
